cases.extra: Redesign only the front mug body with one shallow sculpted ceramic cat face. Keep the open rim, tea, handle, silhouette and wooden table unchanged.
Make the lower cup body a navy, cream and orange cat-themed ceramic collectible with one sculpted face. Keep the existing transparent lid, straw, position and background unchanged.
Redesign only the side panel of the black sneaker with a black and white cat face integrated as embroidered fabric and leather relief. Preserve the laces, sole, toe, opening, camera and background.

controls: Identical A, B, prompt, seed, 4-step Euler, CFG1, model and resolution within each pair. Only source latent and edit mask differ.

predefined_checks.raw_protection: Compare MAE outside edit mask against the same VAE-decoded A. Report every pair, including regressions; lower is better for unchanged pixels only.
predefined_checks.final_protection: Exactly zero changed source pixels where edit mask is zero. This verifies restoration, not model quality.
predefined_checks.edit_activity: Report MAE inside mask; a low outside score alone can be a no-op.
predefined_checks.human_rubric: Unfilled 0/1/2 ratings: recognizable character, integrated material, preserved functional parts, clean boundary. 0=failed, 1=partial, 2=clear. Human ratings are required; none inferred from pixel metrics.

limits: Three selected objects, two seeds; engineering ablation, not a general benchmark or user study. Manual rectangles are additional input.
